Here's what you can expect during these essential check-ups: | Engine Oil Check: We ensure your engine oil is at the optimal level and quality for maximum engine protection. | Engine Inspection: A thorough evaluation to assess the condition of your engine components. | Brake Inspection: Both front and rear brakes are examined for wear and performance. | Brake Fluid Check: We check the brake fluid levels, which is crucial for effective braking. | Cabin Air Filter Inspection: Ensuring your cabin air filter is clean to maintain air quality inside your vehicle. | Coolant Check: Verifying that coolant levels are sufficient to keep your engine at the proper temperature. | Tire Rotation: If necessary, we rotate your tires to promote even wear and extend tire life. | Vehicle Inspection: A comprehensive check of your BMW to identify any potential issues. | Wiper Blade Inspection: We inspect wiper blades for wear and effectiveness in keeping your windshield clear. | When you visit Bimmmer Boys for routine maintenance, such as an oil change, we perform a detailed inspection of all these components. This system utilizes sensors to assess the wear and tear on parts and the lifespan of fluids, ensuring your BMW receives maintenance exactly when it's needed to optimize performance and extend its lifespan. | Early Mileage Checkpoints (0 - 30,000 Miles) | Regular service intervals during the initial 30,000 miles are critical to maintaining your BMW's peak condition: | 10,000 miles: | Replace engine oil, oil filter, and check coolant levels. A comprehensive vehicle inspection and tire rotation are also performed if necessary. | 20,000 miles: | Inspect and replace fuel filters, along with a repeat of the 10,000-mile service. The CBS system is also reset during this service. | 30,000 miles: | Major vehicle inspection that includes checking the HVAC system, exhaust, and suspension systems. Replace brake fluid, and for manual-transmission BMWs, replace the transmission fluid. | Mid Mileage Maintenance (30,001 - 60,000 Miles) | As your vehicle ages, maintaining its dynamic performance and safety becomes crucial: | 40,000 miles: | Engine oil change, brake system inspection, spark plug replacement (if applicable), and tire rotation. | 50,000 miles: | Thorough inspection of engine components and safety systems, including driver assistance sensors and cameras. | 60,000 miles: | Comprehensive service similar to the 30,000-mile check, with additional inspections on transmission components and drivetrain. Replace engine air filter and inspect and replace brake pads and brake rotors as necessary. If necessary, we’ll recommend fluid replacements or top-offs. | Brakes and Suspension | Safety is our top priority. We thoroughly inspect your brake system, including pads, rotors, and brake lines, as well as the suspension components, to ensure they’re in top condition. We inspect the tread depth, check for uneven wear, and ensure your tires are properly aligned and balanced. We check your battery’s charge and overall health, ensuring it’s reliable and ready to power your BMW. | Exhaust and Emissions | We inspect the exhaust system for any leaks or issues and check that your BMW meets emissions standards.
